name: workforce-intelligence-platform
description: AI-Powered Enterprise HRMS — HR, Payroll, Attendance, Compliance, AI Copilot

scripts.db:setup: mysql -u root -p -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_intelligence CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'wfi_user'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'P123/'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON workforce_intelligence.* TO 'wfi_user'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
scripts.db:init: npm run db:create && npm run db:import
scripts.db:reset: mysql -u root -p -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS workforce_intelligence;" && npm run db:init
scripts.db:user: mysql -u root -p -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'wfi_user'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'P123/'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON workforce_intelligence.* TO 'wfi_user'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES; SELECT 'wfi_user created with P123/' AS result;"
scripts.db:create: mysql -u root -p -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_intelligence CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'wfi_user'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'P123/'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON workforce_intelligence.* TO 'wfi_user'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES; SELECT 'Database ready' AS Status;"
scripts.db:verify: mysql -u wfi_user -pP123/ workforce_intelligence -e "SELECT COUNT(*) AS tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='workforce_intelligence'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS users FROM users;"
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d

author: Workforce Intelligence Team
